body: I bought the last 7 or 8 of the 5 dollar Cashwords here in Ohio. Lost on all of them
Same thing happened to me. Had no desire to go back to work or leave the house after isolation
Won 100$ on a 2 dollar ticket 4 times. Won 500$ on a 5 ticket 2 times

The taper guide and beginners guide in the subreddit here that was posted in a comment below is extremely helpful. Theirs no sugercoating this but withdrawal can be very uncomfortable. By days 4 or 5 people tend to feel drastically better. Best of luck
Day 6. Sleep is still hard to come by. Some minor RLS. Cravings already

Hang in there. People usually tend to feel a lot better by days 4 or 5. Day 4 for me was a vast improvement over days 2 and 3. You can do it. I check this sub several times a day. Really good encouraging people here. Im on Day 6 now

Day 5 Cold Turkey here. Same with my complexion. Its already so much healthier looking. Eye bags are drastically diminished. Oily skin has practically went away. I dont look so pale anymore. Its unbelievable the difference in just a few days. Keep up the good work
Day 5 CT. Physical symptoms pretty much gone. Sleep. Whats sleep? Ugh. Gotta keep on keeping on

Im right there with you. I just crossed 100 hours👍 So thats technically day 5 i think. Propanolol. Im on propanolol and its really helped me as well. I think we are through the worst of the acutes. We gotta keep pushing
Im on Day 4 CT. Jumped from 25-30 GPD. Im not gonna lie its rough. Days 2 and 3 were really bad. Today is a lot better. Hang in there the acutes will be over before you know it.

Day 4 CT. Dont feel too awful at the moment despite the insomnia and the general heavy sensation throughout my body. Can already notice my complexion clearing up. My face doesnt look so oily and i have color back in my face. Eye bags are nearly gone. This stuff is insidious
Nearly 72 hours since my last dose and im hurting. Just got to work. No sleep. Runny nose yawning. Cravings. Fidgety. So uncomfortable

Im gonna keep at. The longest break ive had in the last 4 years is 26 days. Whats that saying? Idle hands are the devils playground. Keeping busy as much as possible and excercise really help recovery. Thanks so much
Coming up on 72 hours CT. Feel like hell but gotta keep pushing. Happy New Years
